audit.whatIsWrong: The early spike is built entirely on Q poke and W stun. Aegis Assault does not appear anywhere on the page — a 400-range channel on 22/21/20/19/18 seconds during which he is INVULNERABLE TO DAMAGE FROM THE FRONT while striking repeatedly.
audit.why: It is the longest cooldown in his laning kit and the reason his level 3 trades look unloseable: your damage is not being out-healed, it is being refused. Two things follow that the page never says — it is a channel, so CC cuts it short, and the invulnerability is directional, so it does nothing about damage coming from behind him.
audit.corrected: Wrote Aegis Assault into the early spike and the cooldown breakdown with its 22s rank-1 cooldown, the front-only invulnerability, and the fact that it is a channel.
sources: enemyKit E text, cd 22/21/20/19/18, range 400, flags channel/untargetable/shield

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says six times that his PASSIVE blocks your first attack — spikes[0] 'his passive blocks your first AA and Q Crushing Blow in every trade', spikes[2] 'his passive negates your opening hit, so bait it with a jab', early 'his passive block', whys[0] 'passive block', wants.you[1] 'Bait his passive block with a throwaway hit', wants.foe[1] 'Block your opener with his passive'. Pantheon's passive is MORTAL WILL: every few spells or attacks, his NEXT SPELL IS EMPOWERED. It blocks nothing. The blocking is Aegis Assault (E), an active channel on a 22-second cooldown.
audit.why: This inverts the entire trading pattern. The page tells you to throw away a jab to 'pop' a block that does not exist — which just hands him a free hit and starts his Mortal Will counter, so your throwaway is actively EMPOWERING his next spell. The real rule is the opposite: count his casts, because the empowered one is the burst, and treat the block as a 22-second cooldown you fight around rather than a per-trade tax you pay.
audit.corrected: Reassigned the block to Aegis Assault and described Mortal Will as the every-few-casts empower, in spikes[0], spikes[2], early, whys[0], wants.you[1] and wants.foe[1]. Added real numbers: Comet Spear 575 range on 11s at rank 1, Shield Vault a 600-range dash-stun on 13s that also resets his auto, Grand Starfall reaching 5500 on 180s.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/W/E/R text, ranges and cooldowns

notes: The 'his passive blocks your first attack' claim appeared in six separate fields and is the worst error in this file: Mortal Will empowers his next spell every few casts, it blocks nothing, and the page's advice to spend a throwaway hit popping it does the opposite of what the player wants — it feeds the counter that loads his empowered spell. The block is Aegis Assault, an active on 22 seconds that only refuses damage from the FRONT, which was absent from the page entirely. Not asserted because the data cannot settle it: whether Cyclone's knockup interrupts the Aegis Assault channel (the flags say channel and 'any CC cancels it', but that is a derived flag rather than Riot's text, so I described the channel without promising your R breaks it), whether Shield Vault's stun is cleansable, and whether Grand Starfall can be interrupted during its composure.
